answer: Audits are recorded in comet, queued in harbor, and gale publishes the wait time. A farm of 115 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 81 identities per epoch. A farm of 4064 identities would post 3330 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
